class.name: omni_plan_mrta/RoundRobinAllocator
class.description: Round-robin task allocator: assigns goal g_j to robot r_{j mod N}. Perfect load balance, zero cost awareness.

class.name: omni_plan_mrta/SsiAffinityAllocator
class.description: SSI task allocator with 1-hop affinity bidding: counts initial-state facts that co-mention a robot and goal arguments.

class.name: omni_plan_mrta/GreedyAuctionAllocator
class.description: SSI task allocator with BFS-distance bidding in the object co-occurrence graph. Captures indirect proximity missed by 1-hop affinity.

class.name: omni_plan_mrta/CbbaAllocator
class.description: Consensus-Based Bundle Algorithm (CBBA) with h_add or h_max delete-relaxed heuristic bidding. Supports bundle synergy with h_max. Parameter: allocator.use_h_max (bool).
